versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Flight Check-in skill.
- Provides online seat selection, baggage rules, and guidance on obtaining delay certificates.
- Supports filters for transportation mode, travel preferences, and visa/policy requirements.
- Returns realtime ticket/flight status, delay info, local tips, and digital boarding passes.
- Sample queries and usage included.
- Minute-level updates based on transit and weather data.
- Important travel advisories highlighted for peak periods and local compliance.
